value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly says the transform is almost a straight line, that explicit inversion and simple derivative formulas appear out of reach, and therefore relies on numerical curvature to illustrate non-comparability. The finding replaces that endpoint numerics with exact analytic curvature laws, quantifies the narrow tail geometry by its exact exponential rate and coefficient, and proves at least one curvature transition throughout the strict two-component majorization regime.
